mapper.sql: select s.id, s.teacher_user_id, s.subject, s.class_time, s.class_content, s.class_images, s.status, s.del_flag, s.remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, u.nick_name as teacher_name, (select count(1) from cf_class_review_item i where i.session_id = s.id) as student_count from cf_class_review_session s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.teacher_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into cf_class_review_session (teacher_user_id, subject, class_time, class_content, class_images, status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{teacherUserId}, #{subject}, #{classTime}, #{classContent}, #{classImages}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update:
update cf_class_review_session
class_time = #{classTime}, class_content = #{classContent}, class_images = #{classImages}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime},
where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select i.id, i.session_id, i.student_id, i.fee_id, i.consume_id, i.discipline_score, i.participation_score, i.content, i.images, i.push_flag, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, st.name as student_name, st.avatar as student_avatar, c.hours as consume_hours, greatest(0, f.total_hours - f.used_hours) as remaining_hours from cf_class_review_item i left join cf_student st on st.id = i.student_id left join cf_student_fee f on f.id = i.fee_id left join cf_student_fee_consume c on c.id = i.consume_id where i.session_id = #{sessionId} order by st.name, i.id

select i.id, i.session_id, i.student_id, i.fee_id, i.consume_id, i.discipline_score, i.participation_score, i.content, i.images, i.push_flag, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, st.name as student_name, st.avatar as student_avatar, c.hours as consume_hours, greatest(0, f.total_hours - f.used_hours) as remaining_hours from cf_class_review_item i left join cf_student st on st.id = i.student_id left join cf_student_fee f on f.id = i.fee_id left join cf_student_fee_consume c on c.id = i.consume_id where i.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into cf_class_review_item (session_id, student_id, fee_id, consume_id, discipline_score, participation_score, content, images, push_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{studentId}, #{feeId}, #{consumeId}, #{disciplineScore}, #{participationScore}, #{content}, #{images}, #{pushFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update cf_class_review_item set push_flag = #{pushFlag} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select st.name as studentName, s.subject as subjectLabel, u.nick_name as teacherName, s.class_time as classTime, s.class_content as classContent, s.class_images as classImagesRaw, i.discipline_score as disciplineScore, i.participation_score as participationScore, i.content as content, i.images as imagesRaw, d.dept_name as school from cf_class_review_item i inner join cf_class_review_session s on s.id = i.session_id inner join cf_student st on st.id = i.student_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.teacher_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where i.id = #{itemId} and s.del_flag = '0'
